name: Built-in Workflow Starters
summary: Local NullBoiler workflow templates for multi-step handoffs and evidence collection.

seeds.name: Evidence-Gated Delivery
seeds.description: Plan, execute, verify, and summarize a deliverable with an explicit evidence gate.

plan.prompt_template: Create a short execution plan for {{goal}}.

execute.prompt_template: Execute the plan and collect evidence.

verify.prompt_template: Verify the evidence and identify blockers.

summarize.prompt_template: Summarize outcome, tests, artifacts, and residual risk.

seeds.name: Research to Order Draft
seeds.description: Convert source research into a durable Order draft with citations and follow-up checks.

draft_order.prompt_template: Convert the findings into a policy or schedule Order draft.

review.prompt_template: Check the draft for unsupported claims, missing owner, and missing cadence.

charter.mission: Seed workflow templates that coordinate agents through explicit review and evidence steps.
autonomy_bounds: Workflow templates do not include provider credentials
Human review remains the default before external publication
